text: anya: Pushed a quick Figma of the catalog browse + compare tweaks — link in the thread. Two things stood out when I demo'd to eng: filter chips look great on desktop but feel cramped on mobile, and the performance badges in the compare table start to overlap when there are 4+ columns. @tara @sam can we brainstorm responsive behavior? mike: Nice, saw it. My main concern is discoverability — users need to know what each badge means without a tooltip that disappears on touch. Maybe a persistent legend? :thinking_face: Also version pinning UX: current dropdown is buried inside an overflow menu. feels hidden. tara: Agree on both. For mobile filters I sketched a collapsible filter rail that turns into a single "Filters (n)" button which opens a stacked sheet. Keeps the chips but not all at once. For badges: propose 3-tier priority badges (gold/silver/bronze) + short label. Legend could be a single-line row above the table. sam: From an implementation POV the table cell space is the tricky bit. We can hide less-important badges at <600px and show a summary pill like "2 perf" that expands. Also happy to add CSS `white-space: nowrap` and overflow logic to keep layout stable. leo: Accessibility nit: tooltips aren't reliable on touch or keyboard. If we add a legend, make sure each badge has an accessible name and the legend is tabbable. Example aria suggestion: ```⚡``` and the summary pill should have `aria-expanded` when it toggles. anya: Love the summary pill idea. @mike about version pinning, what if we surface pin at the top of the catalog detail as a small persistent control: "Pinned: v1.3.2" with a one-click change modal? Less hidden + clearer at glance. mike: That would help enterprise users. Also add a small changelog link next to the pin so customers can quickly see what they'd be pinning. tara: UX followup: I'll mock collapse-to-sheet for mobile filters and the summary pill for narrow tables. Also will design a compact legend row that converts to an accessible modal on keyboard/touch. sam: FYI some experimentation notes: we can compute column-priority by last-accessed metrics so frequently compared columns stay visible. Might help automatic prioritization when space is tight. leo: A11y checklist before shipping: keyboard focus order, visible focus states for the summary pill and legend, meaningful aria-labels for badges, and ensure color contrast of badges meets AA. I'll add a short test plan. design-bot: New mock uploaded by tara: "catalog/compare_v3" — review requested. anya: Cool next steps: tara to drop mocks, sam to prototype summary pill behavior, leo to draft a11y test cases, mike to validate enterprise pin preferences with 2 customers. We'll reconvene after mocks. :thumbsup: mike: One more tiny copy thing — change badge tooltip text from "fast" to "latency: " so it's explicit in small screens. anya: noted. thanks everyone. I'll put these as action items in the doc. :spiral_note_pad:
